description: This module allows the administration of Keycloak client authorization permissions using the Keycloak REST API. Authorization permissions are only available if a client has Authorization enabled.

parameters.name: auth_client_id
parameters.description: OpenID Connect client_id to authenticate to the API with. Default: "admin-cli"

parameters.name: auth_client_secret
parameters.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with auth_client_id (if required).

parameters.name: auth_keycloak_url
parameters.description: URL to the Keycloak instance.

parameters.name: auth_password
parameters.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: auth_realm
parameters.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

parameters.name: auth_username
parameters.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: The clientId of the keycloak client that should have the authorization scope. This is usually a human-readable name of the Keycloak client.

parameters.name: connection_timeout
parameters.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API. Default: 10

parameters.name: decision_strategy
parameters.description: The decision strategy to use with this permission. Choices: "UNANIMOUS" ← (default) "AFFIRMATIVE" "CONSENSUS"

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The description of the authorization permission.

parameters.name: http_agent
parameters.description: Configures the HTTP User-Agent header. Default: "Ansible"

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the authorization permission to create.

parameters.name: permission_type
parameters.description: The type of authorization permission. On scope create a scope-based permission. On resource create a resource-based permission. Choices: "resource" "scope"

parameters.name: policies
parameters.description: Policy names to attach to this permission. Default: []

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: The name of the Keycloak realm the Keycloak client is in.

parameters.name: refresh_token
parameters.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

parameters.name: resources
parameters.description: Resource names to attach to this permission. Scope-based permissions can only include one resource. Resource-based permissions can include multiple resources. Default: []

parameters.name: scopes
parameters.description: Scope names to attach to this permission. Resource-based permissions cannot have scopes attached to them. Default: []

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State of the authorization permission. On present, the authorization permission is created (or updated if it exists already). On absent, the authorization permission is removed if it exists. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Authentication token for Keycloak API.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production). Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Manage scope-based Keycloak authorization permission
  community.general.keycloak_authz_permission:
    name: ScopePermission
    state: present
    description: Scope permission
    permission_type: scope
    scopes:
      - file:delete
    policies:
      - Default Policy
    client_id: myclient
    realm: myrealm
    auth_keycloak_url: http://localhost:8080/auth
    auth_username: keycloak
    auth_password: keycloak
    auth_realm: master

- name: Manage resource-based Keycloak authorization permission
  community.general.keycloak_authz_permission:
    name: ResourcePermission
    state: present
    description: Resource permission
    permission_type: resource
    resources:
      - Default Resource
    policies:
      - Default Policy
    client_id: myclient
    realm: myrealm
    auth_keycloak_url: http://localhost:8080/auth
    auth_username: keycloak
    auth_password: keycloak
    auth_realm: master

return_values.name: end_state
return_values.description: Representation of the authorization permission after module execution. Returned: on success

return_values.name: decisionStrategy
return_values.description: The decision strategy to use. Returned: when state=present Sample: "UNANIMOUS"

return_values.name: description
return_values.description: Description of the authorization permission. Returned: when state=present Sample: "Resource Permission"

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: ID of the authorization permission. Returned: when state=present Sample: "9da05cd2-b273-4354-bbd8-0c133918a454"

return_values.name: logic
return_values.description: The logic used for the permission (part of the payload, but has a fixed value). Returned: when state=present Sample: "POSITIVE"

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Name of the authorization permission. Returned: when state=present Sample: "ResourcePermission"

return_values.name: policies
return_values.description: IDs of policies attached to this permission. Returned: when state=present Sample: ["9da05cd2-b273-4354-bbd8-0c133918a454"]

return_values.name: resources
return_values.description: IDs of resources attached to this permission. Returned: when state=present Sample: ["49e052ff-100d-4b79-a9dd-52669ed3c11d"]

return_values.name: scopes
return_values.description: IDs of scopes attached to this permission. Returned: when state=present Sample: ["9da05cd2-b273-4354-bbd8-0c133918a454"]

return_values.name: type
return_values.description: Type of the authorization permission. Returned: when state=present Sample: "resource"

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: Message as to what action was taken. Returned: always
